gsw_content_information.article:
• Observables. When an imported alert from a selected product contains an observable value, the app creates or reuses an observable and records Doppel as a source.
  • Indicators. Alerts that match your configured queue state, entity state, and severity rules create or update indicators. Indicator details include the Doppel alert ID, brand, states, and a link to the alert when available.
  • Indicator status. If Doppel archives an alert or marks its entity as unrelated, the app revokes the existing indicator. If the alert is taken down or the entity is down, the app deactivates the indicator. These status changes preserve the indicator record.
  • Threat Lookup. The lookup checks Doppel live. It returns Unknown when there’s no match, the alert is archived, or the entity state is related or unrelated. For other matches, it returns Malicious if the queue state is selected under Threat Lookup, and Suspicious otherwise.
